title: How Much Computation Does Every Forecast Need? Structured Block Skipping in Two Time-Series Foundation Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.13208v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Time-series foundation models use the same network depth for every input, although forecasting windows differ in structure and difficulty. We test whether whole Transformer blocks can be removed at inference time in two pretrained models: Chronos-Bolt and TimesFM 2.5. Our bypasses avoid the original block computation and preserve the dense model exactly when all blocks are enabled. Masks are selected only on calibration windows and evaluated on 1,088 held-out windows from ETTh1, Traffic, Weather, and Exchange. At moderate sparsity, Chronos-Bolt with 7/11 candidate blocks and TimesFM with 16/20 blocks show little change in mean relative forecasting quality across datasets while reducing median A100 batch-1 latency by 11.2% and 13.4%. More aggressive TimesFM skipping accelerates inference further but substantially harms Traffic and Weather. translated_title: 每次预测需要多少计算量？两个时间序列基础模型中的结构化块跳过
translated_abstract: 时间序列基础模型对每个输入都使用相同的网络深度，尽管预测窗口在结构和难度上各不相同。我们测试了在两个预训练模型（Chronos-Bolt 和 TimesFM 2.5）中是否可以在推理时移除整个 Transformer 块。我们的旁路方法避免了原始块的计算，并且在所有块都启用时能够完全保留稠密模型的输出。掩码仅在校准窗口上进行选择，并在来自 ETTh1、Traffic、Weather 和 Exchange 数据集的 1,088 个留出窗口上进行评估。在中等稀疏度下，使用 7/11 候选块的 Chronos-Bolt 和使用 16/20 块的 TimesFM 在各数据集上的平均相对预测质量几乎没有变化，同时将 A100 单批次中位延迟分别降低了 11.2% 和 13.4%。更激进的 TimesFM 跳过策略进一步加速了推理，但显著损害了 Traffic 和 Weather 数据集上的表现。在两个模型中，不同的等预算掩码在不同的窗口上表现更优，且回溯性 oracle（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究表明时间序列基础模型可以在推理时按预测难度有选择地跳过整个 Transformer 块，在几乎不损失预测质量的前提下将推理延迟降低约 11%–13%。
en_tdlr: Time-series foundation models can selectively skip entire Transformer blocks at inference time, reducing latency by 11–13% with negligible loss in forecasting quality.
